# Printful.com

> Printful is the leading print on demand company for anyone with an idea. We empower entrepreneurs, artists, and creators to create and sell custom-designed products online without inventory risks. Printful handles all logistics printing, packaging, and global shipping eliminating inventory risks and upfront costs, allowing creators to focus on their art while expanding their brand and income.

Printful offers scalable print on demand solutions for enterprises to expand product lines and streamline supply chains. It integrates seamlessly, eliminating capital expenditure, warehousing, and logistical burdens. Printful ensures consistent quality across a vast product catalog, produced on-demand to minimize waste. With API integrations and dedicated support, Printful helps enterprises unlock new revenue streams and achieve operational excellence.
